What I offer

Services

Consulting and advisory across engineering, business strategy, and emerging technology.

Engineering consulting

Technical advisory for hardware, firmware, and systems architecture — from SoC design to embedded systems and wireless technologies (5G, LTE).

💼

Management consulting

Strategic guidance for tech companies navigating product decisions, cross-functional execution, and translating technical concepts into business outcomes.

Education

Teaching STEM students and professionals to skill up — from engineering fundamentals and physics to applied technical concepts, delivered online and in person.

Mentorship

One-on-one guidance for students and early-career professionals — career path planning, transitions into management, interview preparation, and navigating the move from technical to leadership roles.

Background

Experience & education

Sandeep brings nearly 13 years of hands-on experience in embedded systems development, having contributed to some of the world's most respected technology companies — Apple, Intel, Qualcomm, Zeku, and Schneider Electric — delivering firmware and hardware solutions across wireless, SoC, and embedded platforms.

More recently, Sandeep has made a deliberate pivot toward the business side of technology. Through his MBA, he served as a Venture Analyst at the Creative Destruction Lab (UBC), evaluating CleanTech and next-generation compute ventures. He has since taken on a management consulting role with a CleanTech startup, advising on strategy and business development, while also serving as Technical Advisor to a MedTech startup — bringing both engineering depth and commercial acumen to early-stage companies navigating growth.

Working with students & professionals

Mentorship that meets you where you are

With years of teaching experience spanning Superprof, university physics instruction, and hands-on offline tutoring, Sandeep works one-on-one with students and early-career professionals — adapting to each person's background and goals, from complete beginners to experienced engineers looking to level up.
